role: Vice Chair and President of Microsoft
promise: We plan to invest about $80 billion in AI-enabled data centers in fiscal 2025
description: Microsoft announced plans to invest approximately $80 billion in AI-enabled datacenters in fiscal 2025. Brad Smith said more than half of the investment would be in the United States.
evidence: January 3 reporting attributes the fiscal-2025 investment plan to Brad Smith.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked announcement does not reconcile actual capital expenditure to the AI-enabled datacenter scope.

promise: IDA20 announced a $93 billion financing package for its July 2022-June 2025 replenishment cycle.
description: The World Bank announced the package on December 15, 2021. IDA specifies the cycle as July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2025.
evidence: The original announcement establishes the package and date.
IDA's overview establishes the three-year cycle.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the checked announcement and overview do not reconcile final commitments, cancellations and disbursements.

promise: Launch paid unsupervised Tesla ride-hailing in Austin by June 2025 without an onboard human operator
description: Tesla's June 2025 Austin launch carried invited riders with human safety monitors in the passenger seat. That supports a service launch but not fully unsupervised operation.
evidence: The Austin service launched with onboard human safety monitors.

promise: Demand lower interest rates as oil prices fall
description: In his January 23, 2025 Davos address, Trump said that with oil prices falling he would demand an immediate interest-rate reduction. That is a commitment to advocate a change, not to set Federal Reserve policy.
evidence: Fed held rates at 4.25-4.50% until September 2025 — no immediate drop
Analysts noted the president cannot order the Fed to cut rates

review.note: Speech promises to demand a rate cut, conditioned on falling oil prices, not personally enact one. June 30 deadline is absent. The Fed's decision cannot by itself establish whether he made a demand.
